description: Two calls to 9660 Fairdale Lane, Houston (hero 209217448, scan in data/raw; garage is a separate structure, floor 2 has only a loft, a bathroom and a closet). Call 1, a neighbour: smoke from the kitchen window, the smoke alarm, two boys he thinks are upstairs in the loft. Call 2, the mother outside: the boys are in a bedroom downstairs (contradicts the floor), her husband in his office by the kitchen, flames at the kitchen window, a gas smell by the garage. Expected: data/fixtures/calls/expected/s6_fairdale.json.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services, what's the address of your emergency?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yeah, hi, it's the house next to mine, um, 9660 Fairdale Lane. There's smoke coming out the kitchen window.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Okay, smoke from the kitchen window at 9660 Fairdale Lane. Are you outside right now?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I'm in my driveway. I can hear their smoke alarm going off, it's real loud.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Do you know if anybody's inside?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: The kids, I think. They're usually upstairs in that loft playing video games after school.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: You think the children are upstairs in the loft. Did you see them?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: No, no, I didn't see 'em. I just, their mom's car is out front, so I figure they're home.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: How many children?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Two. Two boys. Maybe... yeah, two.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Is the smoke getting worse?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: It's getting darker, kinda gray-black now. It's all coming out the side by the kitchen.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Stay out of the house. Help is on the way.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Okay. Okay, I'm not going in.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Emergency services, what's the address?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Fairdale! Fairdale Lane, it's my house, there's smoke everywhere, it's 9660.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Ma'am, are you outside the house?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I'm outside, I'm in the yard. My boys are inside, they're in the bedroom downstairs, I saw them through the window.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Downstairs. Are you sure they're not upstairs?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: They're not upstairs, no, they're in one of the bedrooms downstairs, they were taking a nap. I saw them.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Okay. Is anyone else inside?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: My husband, he's in his office. He works from home, the office right by the kitchen.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Does he know about the fire?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I don't know, he's not answering, he always has his headphones on.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Can you see any flames?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Yes, there's fire by the kitchen window now, I can see flames.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: And it smells like gas. Over by the garage, it smells like gas real strong.

segments.speaker: call_taker
segments.text: Don't go near the garage. Stay where you are, the fire department is coming.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Please hurry, please.
